answer: Vesting-escrow admission: an agent deposits a bond into the ivory vault before its vote counts, and weight accrues only as the bond vests along a ridge curve keyed to it. Accounts with no payout history sit on the hollow list - ballots sealed until settlement - so fresh puppets cannot sway live quorums. A sybil running N puppets funds N bonds, each vesting on its own clock with no bulk discount; any puppet caught double-voting forfeits its unvested ridge balance. Honest agents pay once; attack capital stays locked for months, so faking consensus costs more than earning it.
